captureTips.title: Good lighting
captureTips.description: Face a window or bright light source. Avoid harsh shadows on your face.

captureTips.title: Fill the frame with your face
captureTips.description: Center your whole face in the oval and move closer so it fills the frame.

captureTips.title: Face camera, hold still
captureTips.description: Look straight at the camera, pull hair back, remove glasses, then hold steady to capture.

disclaimer: This app does not replace a dermatologist and is not a medical diagnosis. If you notice unusual, painful, or rapidly changing skin conditions, please consult a doctor or visit a hospital.
